name: camoufox
description: Camoufox: TypeScript launcher for the Camoufox anti-detect Firefox browser. A port of the Python wrapper.
//playwright-core: Range mirrors python/pyproject.toml's `playwright = "<1.63"`: every Playwright minor is free to change Juggler, so the ceiling is bumped deliberately, with a run of `make -C browser tests`. The dev pin (1.62.0) is the version the Python venv resolves, so the goldens compare like with like.
//@jwriter20/myuri: Pinned to the release python/pyproject.toml pins, so a humanize seed plans the same input in both launchers.
//camoucore: The launcher code camoufox shares with the other CamouBrowser launchers. Pinned to a commit until camoucore 0.2.0 is on npm.
//engines: 22.15 for node:zlib zstd, which the fpgen model archive needs.
